reasoning: On the season so far the Trail Blazers are the stronger team; with home court the Trail Blazers start about 11 points better, in a game of about 227 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Jazz.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Jazz (revenge, confidence).
Bottom line: the Trail Blazers win 79 times in 100, by about 10; most games like this end between 200 and 248 total points.
